sourceTitle: The Yacht Club; or, The Young Boat-Builder
description: "The Yacht Club; or, The Young Boat-Builder" by Oliver Optic is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story centers around Donald John Ramsay, known as Don John, a young man from Belfast who possesses aspirations of becoming a skilled boat-builder like his father.
